perpendicular_distance.description: Orthogonal distance from GPS observation to candidate arc line segment.

distance_rank.description: Rank of candidate arc ordered by orthogonal proximity (0 = closest).

dist_along_arc.description: Distance along candidate arc from start node to orthogonal projection point.

arc_length.description: Metric length of the candidate road arc segment.

arc_bearing.description: Compass orientation angle of candidate arc from start node to end node.

heading_bearing_diff.description: Absolute angular difference between GPS motion heading and candidate arc bearing.

cos_heading_diff.description: Cosine of heading-bearing difference (+1 parallel, -1 opposite, 0 perpendicular).

gps_speed.description: Instantaneous vehicle ground speed from previous observation.

time_diff.description: Time delta between current and previous GPS observation.

distance_travelled.description: Metric Euclidean distance travelled from previous GPS point.

gps_heading.description: Compass heading angle of vehicle trajectory vector.

speed_forward.description: Forward ground speed from current to next observation.

acceleration.description: Temporal acceleration between backward and forward speed.

start_node_degree.description: Degree (number of incident arcs) of the candidate arc's start node.

end_node_degree.description: Degree (number of incident arcs) of the candidate arc's end node.

is_junction.description: Binary flag indicating if either endpoint is a road junction (degree >= 3).

prev_candidate_connected.description: Flag indicating if candidate arc connects topologically to top candidates of previous point.

dist_ratio.description: Ratio of candidate orthogonal distance to the closest candidate's distance.
